mentions.name: CaseDaemon
mentions.description: This tool automates intake handling for immigration lawyers: given a USCIS form plus a set of client documents and information, it automatically fills out the form with what it has and prompts the client (directly or via the user) for additional documentation or information needed to finish the application. It reduces lawyer-client back-and-forth and the busy-work of mapping data to forms and tracking requirements. The product will be ready to use in a few weeks.
mentions.problem: Removes the back-and-forth between immigration lawyers and clients and the busy-work of the lawyer mapping data to forms and tracking requirements.
